newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Santos says finds two new gas fields.
newsitem.headline: Santos says finds two new gas fields.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Monday it discovered two new gas fields from wildcat wells drilled in the Nappacoongee-Murteree block in the South Australian section of the onshore Cooper/Eromanga Basins.
Milluna-1 flowed gas at 7.45 million cubic per day over the interval 2209-2223 metres while Bauhaus-1 flowed gas at 0.84 million cubic feet per day over the interval 2699-2708 metres, Santos said.
Both tests were conducted through a half-inch choke.
Wireline logs indicated gas-bearing sandstone over a gross interval of 116 metres in Milluna-1 and 518 metres in Bauhaus-1.
Santos said both wells would be cased and suspended as future gas producers.
Milluna-1 lies 4.3 km north-east of the Goyder gas field, which would aid its early connection, it said.

Participants in the Nappacoongee-Murteree block are operator Santos, with 59.75 percent; Delhi Petroleum Pty Ltd, a unit of Exxon Corp, with 20.21 percent, Boral Ltd's Boral Energy Resources Ltd, 13.19 percent, Gulf Canada unit Gulf (Aust) Reources NL 4.75 percent, and Cultus Petroleum Ltd's Basin Oil NL 2.10 percent.
